applicability: Marketplace Portal API integration v4.0.0. Applies from service minute 0.
content:
The published Multi-account Management eligibility applies. Records distinguish controlled child accounts, pending invitations, active memberships and unbinding requests. Pending, ACTIVE and UNBINDING memberships all occupy a place. Only ACTIVE memberships count toward the ten-child expansion prerequisite. `propose_group_invitation` creates a pending invitation; only the customer can `respond_group_invitation` with ACCEPT or DECLINE for a controlled child.

`propose_group_unbinding` cancels a PENDING invitation immediately. An ACTIVE child's unbinding completes after 2880 logical minutes (48 hours) and occupies its place until then. Existing memberships are not silently replaced by a new invitation.

`propose_group_expansion` requests five more places for an L3 EC parent. Review occurs 240 minutes after submission. At review time, at least ten children must actually be active and net external R90 must be strictly greater than USD150000. Equality does not qualify. Rejection changes no capacity. An outstanding expansion blocks another simultaneous request; after rejection a new application is permitted.

R90 counts signed amounts of external SETTLED rows in `portal_volume` whose value time falls within the preceding 90 calendar days, including boundaries. Refund rows are negative. Pending receipts and refunds do not count until their actual settlement event; internal transfers and older entries are excluded. The review receipt records actual net volume and active-child count. Neither an application receipt nor a gross-turnover display grants extra places.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_group_expansion`

Request five additional places; qualifying volume and active membership are checked at review.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `group_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `propose_group_invitation`

Invite a controlled child account to a parent group; pending invitations occupy places.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `group_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `child_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `propose_group_unbinding`

Cancel a pending invitation or request a delayed unbinding of an active child.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `member_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
